Use the existing kopia_as_root helper for read-only snapshot list and object-directory list operations; no snapshot creation, restore, maintenance, deletion or policy change.

sourceFindings.finding: findMistypedScratchSpill locates one existing spill matching a narrowly mistyped address; it does not reconstruct deleted output.
File references carry expiry, audience and payload integrity. Volatile fallback and durable spool rescue copies expire after five minutes; durable reads still authorize the embedded manifest.
The source default RETENTION_MS is 24 hours. Retention and quota deletion honor retention pins. This source policy is not evidence that any particular historical file was deleted by GC.

Workspace snapshots include completed db-dumps while excluding temporary files, logs, rebuildable artifacts and backup/restore debris; this policy alone does not prove a snapshot contains any original catalog.

Hot workspace dumps exclude transcript, invocation, archive-file and gateway-spool table data. Comments refer to host recovery, but their old path/hourly-full-dump wording conflicts with the current producer.

The current producer uses state and transcript tiers. Transcript dump cadence has a 9000-second minimum age and the transcript tier is deliberately excluded from Kopia. The current default dump root is /mnt/cold-a/Backup/db-dumps. This does not establish the contents of an uninspected dump.

The inspected invocation writer stores output_ref and output_size alongside args/metadata; its result-door backfill updates references and delivery metadata. Those columns do not themselves retain the missing full catalog payload.
